# FreeForm Fitness — llms.txt

> FreeForm Fitness is an AI-powered strength training platform that provides real-time, per-rep biomechanical analysis using only a camera. No wearables, no hardware. Currently in beta with a free tier. Part of the Kinely ecosystem (kinely.ai).

## Product
- Real-time per-rep biomechanics from one camera
- Scores depth, stability, symmetry, tempo, and ROM for every rep
- 8 supported exercises (squat, deadlift, bench press, overhead press, row, pull-up, lunge, push-up)
- AI fatigue modeling and load recommendations
- AI coaching via OpenAI/Anthropic LLM integration
- Adaptive programming based on performance data
- Video upload analysis for async form review

## Technology
- Client-side MediaPipe Tasks Vision for pose detection
- Python biomechanics engine with exercise-specific models
- FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend (shared with SquatSense)
- Next.js 16 + React 19 frontend
- JWT auth

## Ecosystem
FreeForm Fitness is one of three products in the Kinely ecosystem:
- **Kinely** (kinely.ai) — the AI operating system for fitness
- **TraqGym** (traqgym.com) — gym management + AI agents
- **FreeForm Fitness** (freeformfitness.ai) — AI strength training (this product)
- **SquatSense** (squatsense.ai) — the 30-second squat game

## Company
Kinely · Mumbai, India · Early-stage, first paying customer live
Founded by Robin Carruthers (CEO) and Amit Kumar Das (CTO)
